versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Introduces read-only post-drill inspection for Huawei Cloud.

- Collects instance status and CES metrics across supported services and regions using hcloud.
- Compares status and metrics across drill phases to identify anomalies; abnormal instances are excluded from metric collection.
- Generates an interactive, offline-capable HTML report with topology, status, and metric charts.
- Adds configuration guidance, connectivity checks, and safeguards against cloud resource write operations.
